nativeSourceHashMethod: SHA-256 of native/src/*.cpp then native/include/xenon/*.hpp concatenated in glob order
reproducedMechanism: Overflow that Chromium applies to the viewport (root element, or primary BODY under a visible-overflow HTML root) was treated as a clip at that element's one-screen-high border box, so every node below the first screen failed geometry
innerScrollContainerFinding: Inner overflow panes, sticky/translateZ panes, a dense DOM, page-side scrollIntoView and 120% browser zoom all produced verified lower-page refs on unchanged 0.1.10 source

liveSignatureComparison.source: counts-only report from a live tab, no page content
liveSignatureComparison.note: Same signature (window pageY tracks scroll; no occlusion, unsupported-style or work-limit reasons). The live page DOM was not inspected, so its use of propagated root/body overflow is inferred, not observed.
